name: Singapore Zoo
description: 屡获殊荣的全开放式动物园。园内有精彩的《海洋动物表演》等特色演出，并设有阿明餐厅(Ah Meng Restaurant)等多家内部餐饮。园区提供免费游园摆渡车轻松代步，且到处都有直饮水机，强烈建议自带水壶接水。
descriptionEn: An award-winning, fully open-concept zoo. Features shows like the Splash Safari, plus several on-site eateries including Ah Meng Restaurant. Free shuttle trams make getting around easy, and water refill points are everywhere — bring a bottle.

attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisit: 上午 8:30 或下午（避开正午暴晒，合理安排看表演的时间）
attractionFeatures.bestTimeVisitEn: 8:30 AM or afternoon (avoid midday heat, plan around show times)
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDesc: 成人约 S$48，儿童约 S$33
attractionFeatures.ticketPriceDescEn: Adults approx. S$48, children approx. S$33
highlights: 特色表演：海洋动物表演 (Splash Safari)、动物之友等
内部餐厅：阿明餐厅 (提供本地及西式餐饮)、KFC等
交通便利：提供免费摆渡车 (游园车) 环游园区
环保设施：园区到处可以接水，带水壶即可免费饮用
highlightsEn: Shows: Splash Safari, Animal Friends and more
Dining: Ah Meng Restaurant (local & Western food), KFC and more
Getting around: free shuttle tram around the park
Eco-friendly: free water refill points throughout the park — bring a bottle
